messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a stout quadrupedal salamander-like animal shown in right-facing side view with a broad flat blunt-snouted pale pinkish-gray head with dark speckling, small eyes and a wide mouth, six feathery reddish external gills around the neck, a thick pale wrinkled underbody, four short stout wrinkled legs with splayed clawed toes, and a long broad flattened tapering tail; the entire dorsal surface from behind the head over the back and upper tail is covered in overlapping large brown pangolin-like scales.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat blunt-snouted salamander-like head, pale pinkish-gray with dark speckles and a wide smiling mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the animal"}, {"looks_like": "small round dark eyes with pale rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "six feathery reddish-pink stalked external gills with fine filaments, three on each side", "part": "gills", "where": "projecting from the neck just behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick pale pinkish-white wrinkled soft skin with transverse folds", "part": "torso", "where": "along the underside of the body between the neck and tail"}, {"looks_like": "short stout wrinkled pale pink limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the front chest and two under the rear belly"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed digits with small claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "long broad flattened tapering tail, scaled above and pale below", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the body to the left"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping rounded brown keratinous plates like a pangolin", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back, upper sides, and upper tail from behind the gills to the tail tip"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
